_comment: Known FlowWink fleet — name → Supabase project ref. No secrets here; the DB password is passed via the PGPW env var at runtime. Add new sites as they are provisioned. poolerHost = the instance's Supavisor pooler (user postgres.<ref>, port 6543) — preferred over db.<ref>.supabase.co, which resolves IPv6-only and is unreachable from IPv4-only networks. Look it up via GET https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/<ref>/config/database/pooler.

instances.name: www
instances._note: www.flowwink.com pekar hit sedan nyinstallationen 2026-08-11. Det tidigare refet lever kvar och svarar på psql, edge-anrop och ledgerfragor utan att na nagon trafik — det gav en hel matrunda 2026-08-12 fel svar. Verifiera mot sajten sjalv innan du litar pa ett ref har: curl -sL https://www.flowwink.com/ | grep -oE "[a-z]{20}\.supabase\.co"

instances.name: optic
instances._note: Optic Tunnels AB, femte instansen. Eget Supabase-konto.
